settings.title: One system,
settings.intro: We work across the whole home, so your lights, climate, security, and entertainment feel like one system — not a pile of separate apps.

design.title: Smart lighting
design.text: Dimmers, scenes, and schedules that match your day — from a soft morning ramp to a movie-night dim. We choose fixtures that look like they belong.

design.title: Climate control
design.text: Thermostats and sensors that learn your routine, cut energy waste, and keep every room comfortable without you touching a thing.

build.title: Security & cameras
build.text: Doorbells, locks, and cameras that actually deter — with privacy-first storage and alerts that mean something, not a flood of noise.

build.title: Access & intercom
build.text: Keyless entry, video intercom, and guest codes you can revoke from your phone. Let the dog walker in without handing over a key.

launch.title: Whole-home audio
launch.text: Music that follows you from room to room, hidden speakers, and a setup that sounds as good in the kitchen as it does in the den.

launch.title: Voice & automation
launch.text: One voice assistant that controls the whole home, plus automations that run on their own — 'goodnight' turns off the lights, locks the doors, and arms the system.

settings.title: From walkthrough
settings.intro: A clear, four-step process that keeps you informed and in control — no surprises, no upselling, no half-finished installs.

steps.title: Walkthrough & listen
steps.text: We tour your home, learn how you actually live, and map what you want to control. We recommend only what fits — and explain what we'd skip.

steps.title: Design the system
steps.text: We draw up a plan with a clear budget, a list of every component, and a timeline. You approve it before we order a single part.

steps.title: Install & configure
steps.text: Our certified installers wire, mount, and configure everything — then walk you through it until you're comfortable using it yourself.

steps.title: Support for life
steps.text: Every system comes with a 24-hour support line, remote help, and a maintenance check. If something changes, we're a call away.

settings.note: Most whole-home systems are designed, installed, and running within two to three weeks of the walkthrough. We give you a firm timeline up front and stick to it.

settings.title: The difference is
settings.intro: Anyone can sell you a smart speaker. We design a system that earns its place in your home — and keeps working for years.

features.title: Design-first approach
features.text: We plan around your home and your habits, not a product catalog. The result is a system that feels obvious — because it was designed for you.

features.title: Certified installers
features.text: Licensed, insured, and background-checked on every job. We wire to code and stand behind the work.

features.title: Open standards
features.text: We use open protocols and avoid proprietary lock-in, so your system isn't held hostage to one brand or one subscription.

features.title: One calm app
features.text: Everything — lights, climate, security, audio — lives in one app with one account. No juggling five different apps to turn off a light.

features.title: Honest pricing
features.text: A clear quote before we start, no surprise line items, and no subscriptions you didn't ask for. You own your system.

features.title: Support that stays
features.text: A 24-hour line, remote help, and a maintenance check every year. We're still here long after the install is done.

settings.title: Questions people
settings.intro: Straight answers about cost, compatibility, and what it's like to live with a smart home.

items.question: How much does a smart home system cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope — a lighting-and-climate package might start around a few thousand dollars, while a full whole-home system runs more. We give you a clear, itemized quote before we start, and we'll always tell you what we'd skip if you're on a budget.

items.question: Will it work with the devices I already have?
items.answer: Often, yes. We use open standards and can usually integrate your existing smart devices into the system. During the walkthrough we'll check what you have and tell you honestly what will play nicely and what won't.

items.question: Do I need to be tech-savvy to use it?
items.answer: No. We design the system to be simple — one app, one account, and automations that run on their own. We also walk you through everything until you're comfortable, and our support line is there if you ever get stuck.

items.question: What happens if the internet goes down?
items.answer: Your lights, locks, and security keep working locally — they don't depend on the cloud. Some remote features pause until the connection returns, but your home stays safe and functional.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
items.answer: Yes. Every system comes with a 24-hour support line, remote help, and an annual maintenance check. If you want to add a room or a feature later, we're a call away.

settings.title: Let's make your home
settings.intro: Tell us about your home and what you'd like to control, and we'll come back with an honest sense of what's possible. No obligation, no hard sell.
